documents.title: Emergency Contacts
documents.content: Campus Security: 0949-673-3019, Campus Clinic/Nurse: 0942-0055, National Emergency: 161, Guidance Office: 0948-0979, Discipline Office: 0942-3618, Admin Office: 0682-9572

documents.title: How to Submit a Report
documents.content: To submit a report: 1) Click 'Create a Report', 2) Choose Category + Location, 3) Describe what happened (include when/where), 4) Add evidence (optional), 5) Submit. Clear details help the right office respond faster.

documents.title: How to Track a Report
documents.content: To track your report: 1) Go to the 'Track' page, 2) Enter your reference/ID, 3) View status updates and actions. If you don't have your ID, check your confirmation message/email.

documents.title: Anonymous Reporting
documents.content: If anonymous reporting is enabled by your school, you'll see an 'Anonymous' option when submitting. If it's not visible, it may be disabled by the admin.

documents.title: What Details to Include
documents.content: Include: What happened, Date/time (approx. is okay), Location (floor/room/area), Who was involved (if known), Evidence (optional). Avoid posting sensitive info publicly—use the report form instead.

documents.title: Emergency Button Location
documents.content: You can use the 'Emergency' button in the header (top navigation). It's meant for quick access to urgent hotlines and help.

documents.title: Who Sees My Report
documents.content: Reports are typically visible only to authorized school personnel (e.g., guidance/admin/security) depending on category. If your school supports anonymous reports, your identity won't be shown to reviewers.

documents.title: School Policies
documents.content: All reports are handled confidentially. Student welfare includes bullying, harassment, academic concerns, and mental health issues. Medical-related incidents should be reported immediately. For emergencies, call 161 first.
